name: Hotel Gesser
beschreibung: Hotel Gesser is centrally located in Sillian in East Tyrol, close to the South Tyrolean border. The hotel provides comfortable rooms and authentic alpine gastronomy featuring hearty local specialties. Guests enjoy convenient proximity to the Hochpustertal ski resort as well as picturesque summer hiking and biking trails along the Drau cycle path. A fresh breakfast buffet and welcoming service complete the stay.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gesser in Sillian in East Tyrol features comfortable alpine rooms, traditional dining, a generous breakfast buffet, and proximity to the Hochpustertal ski area.
